title: everything-on-earth discovery entry
description: Schema for a single repository entry discovered by an agent

repo_url.description: Canonical GitHub/GitLab URL (lowercase, no trailing slash, no .git suffix)

description.description: What this repo does in 1-2 sentences

sub_domain.description: Which sub-domain task discovered this repo (matches sub_domain.id in swarm-config)

stars.description: GitHub/GitLab star count at discovery time

tags.description: Added during enrichment stage — normalized topic tags

category.description: Added during enrichment stage — human-readable category

summary.description: Added during enrichment stage — one-line summary

found_in_domains.description: All sub-domains that discovered this repo (populated during dedup)
